review:
Mighty Hot: Amazonia is a retro 5-payline slot with a jungle theme and one of the lowest-volatility games in Wazdan's recent releases: the studio rates it low-medium, with a 96.22% RTP and a 1,500x max win.

There are no respin bonuses or collect symbols here. The main event is the wall of symbols: filling the reels with matching symbols pays the biggest wins, and a fortune wheel then spins to add a multiplier of up to 15x. The rest of the time it plays like a classic fruit-style slot with clear rules and quick spins. It is a good fit for players who want something simple and steady, or who are new to slots and don't want to learn a list of features first.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Free demo available on the Wazdan website
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
